about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: New grad computer engineer from KMUTT, focused on building AI-powered systems and full-stack applications with real-world impact.
about.storyP1: I'm a Computer Engineering graduate (International Program) from King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi. My journey started with C and data structures, and evolved into building AI agents, RAG pipelines, and full-stack web applications.
about.storyP2: Through internships at Botnoi Consulting, Bualoitech, and my current role at The Station Group Holdings, I've worn many hats — AI Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, and Project Manager — gaining hands-on experience in shipping production systems.
about.storyP3: I'm driven by the intersection of AI and software engineering. Whether implementing adaptive RAG systems, designing CI/CD pipelines, or crafting responsive UIs, I aim to build tools that are elegant, efficient, and user-centered.

experiences.description: Wearing three hats: Sprint planning & CI/CD as PM; Frontend/Backend with FastAPI + Agentic AI as SWE; and Agent-to-Agent LLM systems with Adaptive RAG (LangChain/LangGraph/LangSmith) as AI Engineer.

experiences.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack)
experiences.description: Built a chatbot platform with API endpoints and CRUD system. Implemented Agent-to-Agent architecture using LangGraph with MongoDB vector search. Worked with Firebase, Firestore, and authentication systems.

experiences.title: AI Engineer (NLP)
experiences.description: Developed LLM classification and sentiment analysis pipelines. Enhanced LLM performance with RAG architecture. Implemented AI agent workflows using MCP and Bolt.new for software development automation.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects spanning AI engineering, full-stack web development, and creative software — built across internships and coursework.

items.title: Stellia AI
items.description: Full-stack AI chatbot webapp with LLM agents and RAG-based knowledge retrieval. FastAPI backend, Line & Messenger webhook integration, OpenAI/Gemini powered responses.

items.title: BualoiChat
items.description: Chatbot platform with custom API endpoints and CRUD system. Agent-to-Agent architecture using LangGraph, MongoDB vector knowledge base, and Firebase authentication.

items.title: Stock Forecasting
items.description: AI-powered stock trend prediction using Prophet Meta (Facebook). Pulls real-time data from Yahoo Finance API and visualizes trendlines in a pure HTML/CSS/JS dashboard.

items.title: Homemade Steganography
items.description: Python cybersecurity tool that hides encrypted passwords inside images and videos using steganography techniques — encrypt and decrypt via a simple GUI.

items.title: WheelPlay
items.description: Unity wheelchair racing game with Arduino hardware integration, C# physics simulation, 3D models built in Blender, and accessibility-first UI design using Adobe Photoshop.

items.title: BRK-Store CLI
items.description: Command-line store management system written in C. Implements data structures — linked lists, stacks, and queues — with documented test cases and systematic debugging.
